props.headline: Meet the Sun State Team
props.subhead: Sun State International Trucks and Sun State Trailers share one team of 38 people across six Florida locations in Tampa, Sarasota, Davenport and Brooksville — executive staff, truck and trailer sales, parts, service and store management. Together, we'll continue to grow and provide the best service and highest quality trucks and trailers to our customers.

values.heading: Who to ask for at Sun State.

items.title: Who is the CEO of Sun State International Trucks?
items.body: Oscar Horton is CEO. Miriam Horton is VP and Anthony Martell is COO.

items.title: Who do I contact about buying a trailer?
items.body: Scott Anderson is Truck & Trailer Sales Manager and Debbie Hall handles New Truck and Globe Trailer sales. Sun State Trailers sells Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers from the Tampa and Davenport locations.

items.title: Who manages parts and service at each location?
items.body: Jason Velez in Tampa, Paul Royals in Davenport, Mike Velez in Sarasota, Ronnie Jones in Brooksville and Damian Groene at the Tampa Aftermarket center.

items.title: Where is the Sun State team located?
items.body: Six Florida locations: Tampa (6020 E Adamo Dr), Sarasota (1000 Sarasota Center Blvd), Davenport (41609 Hwy 27), Brooksville (17127 Runway Drive), Tampa Aftermarket Parts (7105 E 6th Ave) and Trailer Sales in Tampa.

values.heading: Ready to get on the road?
values.body: Contact us to explore our trucks and trailers and experience nothing less than the dedicated care you deserve.
